articles.title: PUTIN BREAKS SILENCE! Answers Questions on Historic Summit With Trump & Xi Jinping
articles.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin addressed the international press in Shenzhen following trilateral talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and United States President Donald Trump on the sidelines of the APEC Summit. Speaking to reporters, Putin detailed discussions between the three United Nations Security Council permanent members on nuclear non-proliferation, United Nations reform, maritime navigation law, and artificial intelligence safety. On the conflict in Ukraine, Putin stated that Moscow has no intention of prolonging armed hostilities and remains open to a peaceful resolution, noting that Russia accepted compromise terms proposed by the United States, including proposals discussed in Anchorage. However, Putin accused European leaders and authorities in Kyiv of rejecting peace efforts to preserve financial aid and maintain power. Following recent strikes on the Kerch Strait crossing and Crimean Bridge, Putin announced that negotiations regarding infrastructure ceasefires are off the table and confirmed that Moscow will respond while reinforcing terrestrial routes across Zaporizhzhia and Kherson. Emphasizing broader European security architecture and mutual security guarantees, Putin also underscored expanding Sino-Russian strategic relations and announced an upcoming diplomatic visit to Dushanbe to address regional security, Afghanistan, and the Russian 201st military base with Tajik President Emomali Rahmon.
